goal.note: The one-megabyte expectation is the owner's approximate target, not a qualified final measurement. Actual main/actor builds still exceed five seconds.

scope: Lazy imported scheme materialization plus nested shared descriptor call definitions and completed admission. Development Safe/noLLVM evidence; no ABI8/session2 change.

environment.method: Sequential alternating pairs on an otherwise idle host; unpinned affinity. Fresh compiler sessions with disk cache disabled. Build latency excludes startup, guest instantiation and checks; latency_ms includes them. No profiler enabled during throughput pairs.

implementation: Engine retains lazy import names/targets privately and materializes a real binding/scheme at first typed use. No fake type or placeholder certificate reaches Checked/Core. Producer checking, coherence and associated catalog metadata remain complete.
Shared physical reader definitions take descriptor words and capture values as parameters. This slice shares scalar results; aggregate/descriptor result templates stay generator-local.
Shared Unit writers normalize formal owner roles and alias relationships. This slice requires plain stored rows without variants; unsupported cases keep ordinary scoped emission.

Shared keys require fully encoded semantic types, body/binding/public type frontiers, source row identities, invocation context and selected callback evidence. Qualified/captured-goal closures, generative schemes and unsupported opaque key forms decline sharing.

Writer summaries own only physical shapes in the compilation arena, with type environments removed. Nested access effects and transitive scratch regions replay on hits and misses. Pending array destinations cannot be consumed by ABI scratch buffers.

Stable variant-free input shapes permit idempotent per-owner read/write summaries. Completed admission memo separates reader/writer modes, retains relative depth bounds and never skips the first executable body root walk.
